decisions.reason: Moving the battery connector to the back of the Power Board does not change the three-board architecture.

The physical connector location changes, but the NTC contact and mounted-orientation battery-access requirements remain unchanged; placement is already owned by the mechanical form-factor Requirement.
Connector placement does not change the battery protection thresholds, NTC input, or thermal-protection requirement.
The battery connector's physical location does not affect charge-status indication through the Main Board LED chain.
The source decision does not change I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The battery connector's board-side placement does not alter ESP32 sleep policy, power states, or wake sources.
The connector placement change does not alter the switched 5V rail's GPIO control, default state, converter, or sensor-power behavior.
